scope_note: Configuration of the run whose outputs are named MAIN_ae15dbc3: the files this manuscript reports for E1, E2, E4 and E5. It runs with propagator = "exact", so the explicit-step rule never enters it and the correction to that rule left it unchanged. The E3 results the manuscript reports were produced by two later passes under the corrected rule, e3_solver_MAIN_e296b125.csv and e3_solver_MAIN_cb77b145.csv; each records its own configuration in the companion e3_cfl_summary_<prefix>.json, which is the authoritative record for those runs and not this file. Retired E3 files are kept under superseded/ with a README stating why.
